data.narrative:
Sunfire is a Series E climate and energy company founded by Carl Berninghausen, Nils Aldag, and Christian von Olshausen, having raised $315M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparison universe of nine Climate & Energy peers, including one public entity (LNZA) and eight private companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Given the lack of sufficiently narrow peer comparables—the sector yielded zero same-stage peers meeting filtering thresholds and insufficient adjacent-stage data points—the primary applicable method is stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised ($315M) as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.4x multiplier typical of Series E advancement, this method implies a valuation of $441M. This represents the median point in the triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $375M (low) to $507M (high), centered on $441M. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the stage-progression multiplier absent robust peer validation, the reliance on a single quantitative method, and the sparsity of directly comparable companies at Sunfire's stage and capital tier within the Climate & Energy sector. Further refinement would require either a broader multi-method framework or identification of additional comparables with disclosed Series E metrics.
